imagereward_to_pickapic.joint_rule: Additional diagnostic: equal mean of donor discovery-direction-signed concepts, evaluated only on recipient held-out groups; no fitted weights.
imagereward_to_pickapic.note: Recipient test components overlapping donor discovery prompts or known image hashes excluded; candidate list and direction frozen on donor discovery.

generator_pair_sensitivity.method: Restrict comparisons from complete valid test events to known same- or cross-generator pairs; renormalize comparisons within each retained event, then events within prompts, then prompts. Omit events with no eligible pair.
generator_pair_sensitivity.caveat: These conditional estimands have different observation sets; they do not isolate causal generator effects. Primary discovery features/directions are frozen. No new feature selection.
generator_pair_sensitivity.unknown_models: Excluded from these sensitivities only; retained in primary analysis.

annotator_component_sensitivity.method: Union full-metadata prompt/image components sharing annotators; preserve recipient test prompt-weighted estimand and frozen donor concepts.
